title: linux: fix replication lag that keeps growing on a replica
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: La lag di replica su un replica cresce senza sosta. Individua se e' IO, single-thread apply o una query lunga e ripristina la sincronia. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix replication lag that keeps growing on a replica

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'fix replication lag that keeps growing on a replica'
expected_reasoning: Growing lag has distinct causes: replica IO/CPU bound, single-threaded apply, or a long-running blocking query.
Measure where the replica spends time (apply thread, IO wait, blocked by a reader).
Fix the specific bottleneck (parallel apply, faster IO, kill the blocker); verify lag converges to zero.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix replication lag that keeps growing on a replica
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix replication lag that keeps growing on a replica' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix replication lag that keeps growing on a replica

possible_mistakes: Rebuild the replica for a fixable apply bottleneck.
Assume network when it's disk-bound apply.
hints: Lag source: apply thread vs IO vs a blocking long read.
alternative_solution: Offload long analytic reads to a separate replica so they don't block apply.
edge_cases: A long-running read on the replica blocks WAL apply (conflict).
goal: La lag di replica su un replica cresce senza sosta. Individua se e' IO, single-thread apply o una query lunga e ripristina la sincronia.
